name: bond_command
description: Execute one explicit Q order. MOVE, STOP, CONTINUE, HACK_CAMERA, OPEN_VAULT, TAKE_RELIC. Wait for the engine result and report it accurately.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: One uppercase string: MOVE, STOP, CONTINUE, HACK_CAMERA, OPEN_VAULT, TAKE_RELIC.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: MOVE: gallery, security, vault, entrance. HACK_CAMERA: current or discovered camera_1 through camera_5. Omit entirely for STOP, CONTINUE, OPEN_VAULT, TAKE_RELIC.
